redFlags: REGION MISMATCH (critical): Celtic Quest Coasteering is a single-site operator that runs exclusively at Abereiddy Bay / the Blue Lagoon, Pembrokeshire (SA62 6DT). Nothing on the operator's own site, Visit Pembrokeshire, or the National Coasteering Charter member page indicates any branch, mobile unit, or partner operation in Brecon Beacons, Gower, Anglesey, Llyn Peninsula, South Wales, or Mid Wales. The combo pages currently referencing this operator in those six regions are factually wrong and should have the reference removed — only pembrokeshire is a real region for this business.

proposedOperatorData.name: Celtic Quest Coasteering
proposedOperatorData.tagline: Pembrokeshire's Blue Lagoon coasteering specialists at Abereiddy Bay
proposedOperatorData.description:
Celtic Quest Coasteering is a Pembrokeshire-based coasteering specialist operating from Abereiddy Bay, home to the Blue Lagoon — a flooded slate quarry that hosted the Red Bull Cliff Diving World Series in 2012, 2013 and 2016. Sessions run roughly 2-2.5 hours along the right-hand side of the bay, combining scramble climbing, rock hopping, adventure swimming and cliff jumping (up to around 10 metres), finishing in the Blue Lagoon itself. The activity is designed to be accessible to non-swimmers, with wetsuits, helmets and buoyancy aids supplied; standard public sessions take ages 8+, with younger children (5+) accommodated by arrangement.

The business has won Best Visitor Experience at the National Tourism Awards Wales, is AALA-licensed, and is a member of the National Coasteering Charter and the Pembrokeshire Outdoor Charter Group, with public liability cover up to £10 million. Guides meet clients at Abereiddy beach and supply all kit.

Celtic Quest Coasteering operates a single site at Abereiddy in Pembrokeshire and does not run activities anywhere else in Wales — it should not be listed against any other region.
